label.description: Human-readable name for this debug configuration

program.description: Path to the Dart file to debug

useFvm.description: Whether to use fvm to run the Dart/Flutter program

args.description: Arguments passed to the Dart program.

toolArgs.description: Arguments passed to the Flutter/Dart tool (for example --flavor or -d chrome).

env.description: Environment variables to set when launching the debug adapter.

additionalProjectPaths.description: Additional project paths outside cwd that should be considered part of the workspace.

vmServiceUri.description: The VM Service URI to attach to (for attach mode)

vmServiceInfoFile.description: Path to a VM service info file. Provide either this or vmServiceUri for attach mode. Flutter launch configurations may also use this to write per-session VM service connection info.

customTool.description: Optional tool to use instead of flutter or dart when supported by the adapter.

customToolReplacesArgs.description: How many leading tool arguments should be replaced when using customTool.

noDebug.description: Launch without enabling the debugger when supported by the adapter.

debugSdkLibraries.description: Whether to enable debugging for SDK libraries.

debugExternalPackageLibraries.description: Whether to enable debugging for packages outside the current workspace.

evaluateGettersInDebugViews.description: Whether getters should be evaluated in hovers and watch views.

evaluateToStringInDebugViews.description: Whether toString should be invoked in hovers and watch views.

sendCustomProgressEvents.description: Whether the adapter should emit custom progress events when supported.
